title: return-and-adopt
objective: Come back after a gap and get a recap; adopt a chat that was already running by memorizing its history.

checks.goal: a chat played before the gap exists to return to

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 2 }); const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings; if (!s.enabled || !s.profileId) throw new Error(`extraction not configured after import: ${JSON.stringify(s)}`); return s;

steps.send: We meet outside the guild hall at dawn. Arin is still buckling her armour.
I get close to the job board and start reading the postings.

checks.goal: reopening the chat after a simulated multi-day gap shows the away recap

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ enabled: false }); await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 1500)); return globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings;

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const blob = ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; const id = blob.selectedStoryId; if (!id) throw new Error('no story selected in chat metadata: ' + JSON.stringify(Object.keys(blob))); const away = new Date(Date.now() - 3 * 24 * 3600 * 1000).toISOString(); blob.stories[id].extras.lastSessionAt = away; await ctx.saveMetadata(); const stored = ctx.chatMetadata.story_orchestrator.stories[id].extras.lastSessionAt; if (stored !== away) throw new Error(`lastSessionAt overwritten before reload: ${stored}`); return { id, stored };

checks.goal: the recap names the checkpoint the player left off at, then dismisses cleanly

steps.eval: const button = document.querySelector('dialog[open] .popup-button-ok'); if (button) button.click(); await new Promise((done) => setTimeout(done, 500)); return { dismissed: !document.querySelector('dialog[open]') };

checks.goal: mid-chat adoption: memorizing the backlog fills memory from history already in the chat (real model)

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; await rt.runMemorizeBacklog(); const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); const entries = snapshot.memory.entries.length; if (!entries) throw new Error(`memorize backlog produced no memory: ${JSON.stringify(snapshot.memory.backfill)}`); return { entries, backfill: snapshot.memory.backfill };

checks.prompt: After the gap, did the recap actually put you back in the story — enough to take your next turn without scrolling up?
checks.anchors: 1 = useless · 3 = reminded me of the checkpoint only · 5 = I knew exactly where I was and what was open

checks.prompt: Adopting an already-running chat: was it clear that the extension had caught up on what happened before?
checks.anchors: 1 = no idea whether it worked · 3 = saw it finish · 5 = obvious, and the story used what it learned
